objective: Establish a traceable multi-source scientific validation protocol and machine-readable per-run evidence template without changing scientific selection rules or released artifacts.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Issue #170: CPVS exact-membership remains unresolved at 741786 candidates, 730184 published reference IDs, 11602 candidate-only, and 0 published-only.
Issue #180: deterministic CPVS samples and object-level full-vs-batch validation are required and remain separate from this multi-source track.
Issue #188: multi-source validation requires complete input/output/operation/error/root-cause/remediation traceability.
The cumulative improvement ledger requires explicit facts/hypotheses and NOT_MEASURED rather than fabricated measurements.
v0.2.0 baseline and v1.0.1 release artifacts must remain unchanged.

baseline.status: Repository already has a scientific validation roadmap and cumulative lifecycle controls; the roadmap does not yet provide a dedicated, comprehensive multi-source run manifest contract. No Gaia DR3 or TESS acquisition was performed in this cycle.

expected_improvement: Define distinct validation claims for acquisition, parsing, identity, transformations, determinism, reference agreement, and model validity.
Specify complete provenance and operation logging including hashes, counts, commands, configuration, environment, errors, hypotheses, remediation, regression tests, and reruns.
Add a machine-readable run manifest template with explicit NOT_RUN/NOT_MEASURED states.
Keep Gaia DR3 and TESS pilots bounded and version-pinned, with ingestion integrity separate from model-performance claims.
Record the multi-source work under Issue #188 without replacing or closing CPVS issues.

protocol_coverage.before: Dedicated multi-source protocol and per-run manifest template not present in the inspected main-branch files.
protocol_coverage.after: Protocol and JSON template added on branch; validation of the template/schema and any actual data run are NOT_MEASURED at this stage.

scientific_validity.after: No scientific selection, model, dataset, or release artifact changed; CPVS remains unresolved. Gaia/TESS execution NOT_RUN.

traceability.before: Existing lifecycle records and evidence conventions available, but no dedicated multi-source per-run template found in the inspected files.
traceability.after: Template captures source/version/queries/hashes, environment, stages, counts, errors, incidents, interpretation, and review fields; automated validation tests are still required.

evidence: Created GitHub Issue #188 to track source sequence, phases, acceptance criteria, error taxonomy, and audit-trail requirements.
No external dataset was acquired or analyzed in this cycle.
No scientific code, model, dataset, v0.2.0 baseline artifact, or v1.0.1 release artifact was changed.

root_causes: The project already had general scientific-validation and lifecycle documentation, but a dedicated multi-source run contract spelling out every input, transformation, output, error, root-cause hypothesis, remediation, and rerun had not been established in the inspected main-branch files.

findings: Acquisition integrity, schema/identity correctness, reference agreement, and model validity are separate claims and require separate evidence.
Different astronomical surveys must not be assumed to share feature semantics, cadence, units, selection functions, taxonomies, or label quality.
A failed or skipped stage must be recorded explicitly and cannot be treated as success.
Suspected causes remain hypotheses until a discriminating test verifies them.
Successful Gaia/TESS ingestion cannot resolve the CPVS membership discrepancy.

open_blockers: Validate the JSON template and add tests/schema checks before treating it as an enforced contract.
Add a report/manifest generator that logs each stage and preserves failure evidence.
Run a bounded, pinned external-source pilot only after its query and schema contract are documented.
Verify source artifacts and outputs with SHA-256 and row/object accounting.
Keep CPVS exact reconstruction UNRESOLVED until its own evidence supports a different disposition.

knowledge_carried_forward: Issue #188 is the tracking record for multi-source validation.
The protocol is a plan, not evidence of data acquisition or scientific validation.
No Gaia DR3 or TESS run has been completed in this cycle.
CPVS blocker #170 and deterministic sample/full-vs-batch work #180 remain independent and open.
